data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word avis meaning 'bird'. The name Avera was used in ancient Rome as a name for a bird of prey, such as an eagle or hawk. In Christian tradition, the name Avera has been associated with the idea of being an avenger, a protector, or a defender. The name Avera carries the meaning “Bird of prey, avenger” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Avera usually hope their child will grow to embody bird of prey, avenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
